name: proofread-mcp
description: Check US and Swiss case citations against open registers of court opinions.
long_description: proofread.law checks every case citation in a draft against an open register of about 10 million US court opinions (CourtListener bulk data). Each row comes back as red (check this: the register holds something concrete that disagrees), orange (cannot verify: nothing to check against, such as a Westlaw or Lexis identifier), green (found) or, with the opt-in deep check, whether the opinion supports the sentence it is cited for. Every result carries the coverage statement. A checked text is not stored; saving a brief is opt-in (stored encrypted in your account, deleted when you delete it), so you can edit it and re-check what changed. For Swiss law, suggest_cases takes a statute article (Art. 41 OR, art. 9 Cst.) and lists the leading Federal Supreme Court cases cited with it, as cases to read (paid plans and trials for now). Not covered: Westlaw/Lexis identifiers, statutes, regulations, secondary sources, whether a case is still good law.

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Check the case citations in a text; red, orange, green rows with the coverage statement

tools.name: check_document
tools.description: Check the case citations in a PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown file on disk

tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Look up one citation in the register: which case, court, date, parallel citations, coverage

tools.name: resolve_citations
tools.description: Look up a list of up to 500 citations in one call

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What the register holds and cannot check, and the storage notice

tools.name: render_report
tools.description: Render a finished check as a markdown diligence report

tools.name: suggest_cases
tools.description: Swiss only: a statute article to the leading Federal Supreme Court cases (BGE) cited with it, to read, grouped by field, with the quoted passage and any later change of practice

tools.name: save_brief
tools.description: Save a brief to the user's account (opt-in, stored encrypted) and check its citations

tools.name: list_briefs
tools.description: List the briefs saved in the user's account

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Get a saved brief's text, latest report and versions

tools.name: update_brief

tools.name: delete_brief
